News

  • Council sets rates, adopts Annual Plan and Fees and Charges Schedule

    24 Jun 2026, 4:01 pm

    Today the Council set the rates and adopted the Annual Plan for the 2026-27 financial year.

  • Testing the numbers on Council restructure options

    23 Jun 2026, 11:32 am

    Environment Southland has developed a financial model to test the costs and savings of local government restructure options for the region.

  • Recent Old Man’s Beard sighting shows need for pest plant checks

    22 Jun 2026, 11:32 am

    Environment Southland is urging residents to check their properties and gardens for any sightings of the pest plant, which poses a significant threat to native vegetation and forest ecosystems.

  • Southlanders need to prepare for ‘Super El Niño’ weather conditions

    19 Jun 2026, 9:26 am

    Earth Sciences New Zealand is predicting a ‘Super El Niño’ weather system to develop later this year. El Niño’s tend to bring colder, windier, and wetter than average weather for Murihiku Southland.

  • Rates Database Availability

    12 May 2026, 4:03 pm

    ​The rates database for the Southland Regional Council (trading as Environment Southland) is available for inspection during office hours.

  • Datagrid NZ Partnership Limited - Resource Consents

    13 Mar 2026, 1:31 pm

    Copies of the resource consents granted to Datagrid for the datacentre near Makarewa.

  • Hearing - Dangerous, Earthquake-prone and Flood-prone Dams Policy

    2 Dec 2025, 8:00 am

    This hearing will be held in Regional House, 220 North Road, Waikiwi, Invercargill

  • Southland Civil Defence Emergency Management Group

    6 Nov 2025, 8:30 am

    There is to be an emergency meeting of this group held in the Council Chamber, 220 North Road, Waikiwi, Invercargill
